results.note: The shipped manuscript script prints 0.057 at three decimals (Table 1, column 1), a gap of 0.002 from 0.055. The deterministic gap exceeds one unit in the last printed digit; no specific reporting slip was identifiable.

findings.description: The MTurk treatment coefficient does not reproduce the approved printed value: the shipped script yields 0.057 rather than 0.055.
findings.evidence: Successful full manuscript-script run (exit status 0); console output in logs/manuscript-run-4.txt.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the paper's Table 1 value against the archived analysis output and document any correction; no analysis change was made in this check.

limitations: This checks computational reproducibility only and makes no judgement about the scientific conclusion.
The successful run executed the manuscript script unchanged from the package directory so its relative data paths resolved.
The displayed coefficient values are at three-decimal table precision; p values were not part of the approved claim list.
The run emitted an expected many-to-many join warning in the NYT text analysis and an ignored geom_col size-parameter warning; execution completed with exit status 0.
